nodes.description: address public owner of Owned; set from msg.sender and changed by acceptOwnership
address public ownerCandidate; pending owner written by changeOwner and consumed by acceptOwnership
uint public multiplier; percentage used to compute participant payout in deposit
uint public payoutOrder; index into the participants queue incremented inside payout
address powh_address; stored external POWH target used by notPowh and weak_hands
POWH weak_hands; external contract instance called from payout and withdraw
Participant[] public participants; FIFO queue of etherAddress/payout structs storing investor claims
Owned() public constructor; initializes owner with msg.sender
changeOwner(address) public onlyOwner; writes ownerCandidate
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == ownerCandidate then promotes it to owner
POWH.buy(address) public payable; external target invoked with .value().gas()
POWH.withdraw() public; external target invoked with .gas()
BoomerangLiquidity(uint,address) public constructor; sets multiplier, powh_address and weak_hands
function() payable public; empty fallback that accepts ether without bookkeeping
deposit() payable public; pushes a Participant with msg.value*multiplier/100 then calls payout
payout() public; sends half the balance to weak_hands then loops over participants paying out and advancing payoutOrder
withdraw() public; delegates to weak_hands.withdraw with a fixed gas stipend
donate() payable public; empty payable function that lets anyone add ether to the pool
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) public onlyOwner notPowh; forwards an ERC20 transfer to owner
ERC20Interface.transfer(address,uint) returns(bool); external token implementation entry point
msg.sender; controls owner assignment, participant identity, external call arguments and privileged checks
weak_hands.buy.value(investment).gas(1000000)(msg.sender); external payable call into a contract chosen at construction
participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.send(payoutToSend); low-level send returning a boolean
participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.call.value(payoutToSend).gas(1000000)(); unchecked low-level call used when send fails
weak_hands.withdraw.gas(1000000)(); external call with fixed gas into the POWH contract
ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens); external call into an arbitrary user-supplied token contract
(msg.value * multiplier) / 100; unchecked multiplication that can overflow before division
balance -= investment, balance -= payoutToSend and participants[...].payout -= payoutToSend; unchecked subtractions on unsigned values
payoutOrder += 1; unchecked array-index increment inside the payout loop
_newOwner parameter of changeOwner
multiplierPercent parameter of the BoomerangLiquidity constructor
powh parameter of the BoomerangLiquidity constructor
unnamed address parameter of POWH.buy
tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token
tokens parameter of transferAnyERC20Token
uint balance local in payout holding address(this).balance
uint investment local in payout = balance / 2, forwarded to weak_hands.buy
uint payoutToSend local in payout clamped to the current participant payout
